blocks.content:
Appointment (Article 155): Appointed by the President.

Qualifications (Article 157):
• Citizen of India
• Minimum age – 35 years

Conditions (Article 158):
• Cannot be a member of Parliament or State Legislature
• Should not hold any office of profit

items: Article 155 deals with appointment by the President.
Minimum age required for qualification is 35 years under Article 157.
Article 158 specifies that the appointee must not hold any office of profit or be a member of Parliament/State Legislature.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Governor is appointed directly by the President under Article 155.
Qualifications under Article 157 require being a citizen of India and achieving a minimum age of 35 years.
Article 158 outlines conditions stating the Governor cannot be a member of Parliament or State Legislature and should not hold any office of profit.
